subject.title: Inject sibling agent list into session system prompt

question: Should sibling-agent roster metadata be model-visible through the session prompt, a gated discovery tool, or not exposed in core?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but exposing ids, names, roles/themes, and A2A permission topology changes the model-visible security and product boundary.

options.title: Use Gated Discovery Tool
options.body: Expose a bounded roster only through an authorized allowlist-aware tool result, with explicit fields and tests for redaction/permission behavior.

options.title: Inject Prompt Summary
options.body: Add a minimal prompt section for allowed siblings, accepting prompt growth and broader model-visible topology exposure.

options.title: Reject Core Exposure
options.body: Keep sibling context in operator-maintained docs or external tooling until a broader roster/security design is approved.

recommendation.title: Use Gated Discovery Tool
recommendation.body: Expose a bounded roster only through an authorized allowlist-aware tool result, with explicit fields and tests for redaction/permission behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest feature-history signal for `agents_list` and multi-agent discovery boundaries.
